summary: An unidentified hiker in a family party suffered severe injuries around noon Thursday while descending a snowfield above Browns Lake near Tabeguache Peak; two siblings hiked out to the Browns Creek trailhead and called 911 at 4 p.m. A REACH Air Medical Services helicopter could not land on the steep talus field, so three Chaffee County SAR North members were flown to the scene, hauled the patient 900 ft up the slope to a landing zone, and the hiker was airlifted at 8:56 p.m.; all parties were out of the field by 2 a.m. Friday.
location: Above Browns Lake, near Tabeguache Peak
notes: Date pinned to Thursday 2017-07-20 (weekday-verified; article asset date July 24, 2017, consistent with a Friday press release and the Thursday 8:56 p.m. airlift/Friday 2 a.m. clear). Six vehicles staged up Baldwin Creek for a radio relay to evacuate the four remaining family members.
